# `company.crm_conversions`

Lead-to-customer links, each a reversible batch; reversed links remain as history.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this conversion. |
| `lead_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ux_crm_conversions_active_lead | crm_leads.id | Converted lead. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_crm_conversions_customer | customers.id | Top-level customer the lead became or was linked to. |
| `target` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | new: a customer this conversion created; existing: an existing customer. |
| `batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | batches.id | The reversible batch that holds this conversion. |
| `request_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Digest of the request, so an identical retry returns this receipt. |
| `lead_version_before` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Lead version the conversion expected. |
| `lead_version_after` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Lead version the conversion left. |
| `lead_status_before` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Lifecycle restored by reversal. |
| `lead_close_reason_before` | VARCHAR(1000) | yes | — | — | — | — | Close reason restored by reversal; null when open. |
| `customer_version_before` | INTEGER | yes | — | — | — | — | Existing customer version expected; null for a new customer. |
| `customer_version_after` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Customer version the conversion left. |
| `lead_label` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | Lead display name captured at conversion. |
| `customer_label` | VARCHAR(400) | no | — | — | — | — | Customer name captured at conversion. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_crm_conversions_customer | — | active or reversed. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | ix_crm_conversions_customer | — | UTC time of the conversion. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that converted the lead. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface used. |
| `reversed_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC time the conversion was reversed; null while active. |
| `reversed_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Principal that reversed it; null while active. |
| `reversal_batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | batches.id | Reversal batch; null while active. |
